kind: introspection repair (gate completion tail, follows hv-umm2.492)

measurementWindow.dispatchSource: worktree .git birth time (the subagent started after it)

change.effect: The default reporter drops console output attributed to passing tests and, on failure, prints the failing test's, suite's or file's captured console output beside the failure. src/logging.ts, the D40 transports and scripts/review.mjs are unchanged.

method.command: lockf -k artifacts/heavy.lock env -u AI_AGENT -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE sh -c '{ npm run review:gate 2>&1; echo EXIT $? <iso time>; } | node throttle.mjs <out> 118'
method.wholeSuiteTrigger: a temporary comment appended to src/logging.ts (161 related test files > cap 40, so test-gate ran all 343 files); reverted before commit
method.agentEnvUnset: Vitest 4.1 picks its agent reporter, which defaults to silent "passed-only", when std-env detects an AI agent (AI_AGENT, CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE). Tollgate's gate runs without those variables, so they were unset to reproduce the gate's default reporter.
method.consumer: throttle.mjs reads stdout+stderr in 8192-byte frames every 118 ms (~68 KiB/s, the drain rate hv-umm2.492 observed) and holds at most 64 KiB, so the producer sees pipe backpressure
method.internalFinish: test-gate 'started at' time plus its 'finished in' seconds
method.producerExit: the EXIT line's time, taken after npm run review:gate returned
method.rawEvidence: artifacts/qa/hv-umm2.496/ (before.out, after.out, before-agent.out, *.meta.json, *.load, failing-proof.out, full.out, throttle.mjs, tail.mjs)

after.remainingTestGateOutput: one pass line per test file (343) plus about 110 '[qa]' lines (17.5 KB) that scripts/qa/run-scenario.mjs say() writes with process.stderr.write during scripts/qa tests

agentReporterReference.note: Same whole-suite gate with the agent variables set, before the change: what agent sessions saw locally all along.

failingTestLogEvidence.throwawayTest: src/throwaway-hv-umm2-496.test.ts (deleted): one passing and one failing test, each calling logEvent with a distinct marker event
failingTestLogEvidence.command: env -u AI_AGENT -u CLAUDECODE -u CLAUDE_CODE npx vitest run src/throwaway-hv-umm2-496.test.ts
failingTestLogEvidence.result: exit 1; the failing test's logEvent JSON line printed under 'stdout | src/throwaway-hv-umm2-496.test.ts > failing test logs'; the passing test's marker absent (0 matches); with --silent=false both markers print

reviewMjsReplay: Not changed. After the config change the buffered test-gate block is 72.7 KB, about 1 s at the observed drain rate, and it carries the pass/fail summary the gate log needs.
